verdict.rationale: Devin has a documented REST API for building integrations and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of users (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9). It also has an official Devin MCP server that exposes sessions, playbooks, knowledge and scheduling to other agents (devin-docs-15, devin-docs-29). However, the evidence never mentions any official language SDK or client library, and no OpenAPI spec was found for generating one (devin-probe-2). Missing for 10: any documented official SDK packages (e.g. Python/TypeScript), a published OpenAPI spec, SDK examples or reference docs, and independent corroboration of building against an SDK.
